visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair sits on a white sofa, dressed in a black sleeveless top, focused on her smartphone; a white projector is visible on the dark wall behind her. (2) After a visual glitch effect, she suddenly appears in a classroom setting, wearing a white school uniform with an orange emblem and black-rimmed glasses, looking around in total confusion. (3) She looks down at a wooden desk containing a green and white math textbook and a pencil case, then points in shock at a green chalkboard displaying a countdown for a major exam. (4) The woman holds up a pink square mirror to her face, revealing several red, inflamed acne spots on her cheeks and forehead; her expression is one of extreme distress and sadness. (5) A cartoon illustration of a traditional deity (Wenchang Dijun) in purple robes appears on the right side of the frame, holding a calligraphy brush and presenting three skincare products. (6) The woman holds three Benzac skincare products—a blue face wash, a purple gel, and a white lotion—while smiling at the camera in the classroom. (7) Close-up shots show the woman washing her face with white foam in a bathroom, then applying a white gel from a purple tube onto her spots, and finally rubbing a white lotion onto her cheeks. (8) Her skin appears clear, smooth, and glowing as she smiles and touches her face, framed by a lit vanity mirror. (9) She displays a purple and gold gift box containing the skincare set and three special pencils, posing with a thumbs up in her blue school uniform.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator and a brief graduation photo featuring two women.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long black hair, wearing a black top initially, then a white school uniform with glasses, and later a light blue t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video shifts between a modern home with a dark gray wall and projector, a studio-set classroom with wooden desks and a chalkboard, and a bright bathroom with a lit mirror and vanity sink.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo, bright acoustic guitar strums and a cheerful, fast-paced female voice providing narration. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition, followed by the female voice shifting to a tone of exaggerated shock and surprise with rapid vocal inflections. (3) A magical digital chime sound signifies the appearance of a character, accompanied by a deep, resonant male voice speaking with calm authority and steady rhythm. (4) The BGM transitions into a steady, upbeat pop beat with electronic percussion as the female narrator begins a professional product demonstration. (5) Bubbling and watery splashing sound effects are heard as she describes the cleansing step, maintaining a high vocal pitch and energetic delivery. (6) A sharp 'ding' bell effect rings out for every product feature highlight, with the female narration accelerating to cover scientific benefits. (7) The music reaches a high-energy plateau with bright synthesizer layers as the female voice becomes triumphant and encouraging, ending with a final positive flourish in the BGM.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Story/Conflict -> Educational Demo -> Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Benzac's three-step skincare routine by associating the product with high-stress student life and presenting it as a miraculous solution for acne.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator demonstrates the products in detail, lists their scientific benefits, and provides a call to action with a special gift set.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a popular 'time travel' skit format to create relatability with students, effectively transitioning from a comedic story to a highly technical product tutorial.
